note: hero-idle-sheet.png contains 8 frames: frames 0 and 2-7 are the original breathing/shifting idle loop, stepped through by the CSS sprite animation in main.css (steps(frameCount - 1, end), i.e. steps(7, end) — not steps(frameCount, end) — so each step lands exactly on a frame boundary instead of a fractional offset). Frame 1 is a full-frame replacement (not a partial eye/eyebrow crop pasted over the original frame) using the closed-eyes half of a user-supplied reference image, since none of the original 8 frames isolated eye state on its own — they all varied across a broad breathing-shift region instead. The reference's open-eyes half was verified to align with hero-static.png's own silhouette (97%+ IoU, <2/255 mean color diff in the sign-board region) before computing the fixed pixel offset (dx=-1, dy=-659) used to place the closed-eyes half onto the canvas; the whole frame was replaced at that offset rather than compositing a cropped region, since a full clean swap has no internal seam to misalign. The 'wander' behaviour in hero.js (walking toward/away from the venue) is a separate, additional idle behaviour layered on top of this frame animation.
